record.reference: Mercantile Bancorp publicly declared a 3-for-1 split when the stock closed at $65, implying about $21.67 post split. The frozen SEP tape has a stale zero-volume $65 row on the vendor effective session and the first traded post-event row closes near $22, so the canonical share multiplier is 3.0 and the same-session derived 1.0 witness is rejected as stale-price evidence.
